# AirJump

**Category:** Movement  
**Aliases:** Air Jump, AirJump

## What it does

AirJump lets you jump again while you're already off the ground, giving you extra height or a second boost without touching solid ground. It's handy for reaching ledges, crossing small gaps, or stringing together moves that a normal single jump can't pull off.

Description basis: [publisher description](https://liquidbounce.net/docs/modules/movement/airjump). The module's behavior on a stock Minecraft 26.3 server has not been verified unless separately documented in [research](../../RESEARCH.md).
